title: SEASON ZERO M3: THE WORKBENCH WORKS ON GEAR
why: his rulings of 11-01: reroll one trait for dollars at the workbench (67), salvage unwanted gear into materials (66), most the money should come from selling gear; plan worn gear and stations
now: the trader has a gear tab beside craft: every stash piece with name in rarity colour, power, pips and traits; each trait has a reroll button with its price, a quarter of the sale value and up by half each time; hold to sell pays the sale price and counts in lifetime earnings; hold to salvage gives 2, 4, 8 or 14 materials worth about 80 percent of a sale; keys and pad get a confirm card; worn pieces are not offered; net worth counts gear in the stash and worn; never in the demo

function wornTraitRoll(s,rar,pw,R){ return Math.round(WORN_STATS[s].base*rar.mul*wornPwMul(pw)*(0.75+0.5*R())*1000)/1000; }
